basics.name: Paul Gilliam
basics.title: Strategic Product Leader - Platform Innovation & Market Category Creation
basics.summary: Strategic Product Leader with proven ability to identify untapped market opportunities and build category-defining platforms that create sustainable competitive advantages. Track record of transforming traditional SaaS products into differentiated ecosystems, generating $5M+ in new revenue streams through market-validated innovation. Expert at establishing systematic customer discovery programs that uncover multi-million dollar opportunities competitors miss. Specializes in platform architecture thinking that consolidates fragmented markets into unified competitive advantages.

highlights: Transformed traditional SaaS into $5M+ platform ecosystem through payment infrastructure, analytics licensing, and competitive moat development
Identified $100M+ van line market opportunity through platform economics analysis, demonstrating strategic market positioning capabilities
Built and personally sold analytics platform achieving 100% enterprise beta retention rate, establishing new market category for operations intelligence
Generated $150K ARR through strategic API ecosystem development, creating revenue streams unavailable from market competitors
Established systematic customer discovery program with 25+ monthly executive interviews uncovering market opportunities competitors systematically miss
Led platform consolidation strategy creating sustainable competitive advantage where competitors required 5 separate tools with $300 manual overhead per operation
